Messages.Author: Jeffrey S. Pease
Messages.Body:
I'm sure this has been discussed, but I can't find it on the
rules/errata/clarification web site.

Theft of Vitae says "Usable at long range."

I believe this to mean it can be used either at short range(the default)
or at long range. I could see someone arguing that by card text, it
specifies usable at long range, and by exclusion that it is not usable
at short range. Which is it?

Thanks,
Jeffrey

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Usable at either close or long range.
